name: Meredith Parks and Recreation Summer Camp
description_short: A town-run weekday day camp at the Meredith Community Center for kids entering grades K-8. Activities include games, arts and crafts, daily outside time, walks, baking and cooking, and field trips.
refund_policy_summary: Prices are weekly and there are no daily rates. You are not reimbursed for days your child is absent. If your child is signed up for a week with a field trip, you owe the field trip fee. Changing 3-day option days needs two weeks' written notice, or you are charged the full-week price.
special_needs_notes: If your child gets extra help from staff at school, email Sarah (sperkins@meredithnh.gov) to set up a meeting about camp options for your child.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page; rechecked 2026-11-13
The department's Registration page: all registrations are now completed online through its Register Now site.

warnings: This notice is for the 2026 season, which is already over (today is 2026-10-13). No 2027 information was found.
The 2026 camp dates are listed only as 'TBD (8 weeks)', so no sessions are recorded. Registration opened 5/1/26 for Meredith residents and 5/5/26 for everyone else.

price_per_week is the resident rate for 1 child, full day ($125). Non-residents paid $175. price_min/price_max cover the 1-child rates from resident half day ($63) to non-resident full day ($175). Families with 2 or 3+ children paid family rates up to $285/week. The 3-day option cost $80-$177/week. Early drop-off and late pick-up each cost $25 (resident) or $35 (non-resident) per family per week. Field trip fees are extra.
This is a price notice that came out before the full camp packet, not the full camp packet itself.
